tools.name: list_python_skill_files
tools.title: List Python Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the SEMOSS 'python' skill, the platform's guidance for writing Python that runs inside the SEMOSS Python runtime: py/mcp_driver.py, helper modules, and anything invoked through the platform's Python bridge. Call this when the user asks what SEMOSS injects into Python (ROOT, the active insight context), what to import from ai_server / semoss / smssutil, how to expose a Python function as an MCP tool with the @mcp_metadata decorator, file I/O relative to ROOT, or how Python reaches Pixel via Insight().run_pixel(...). Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md. Not for Java reactor authoring or frontend @semoss/sdk calls; for the Pixel commands themselves see the database, model, and vector skills.
